scores.evidence: Nothing overflows, no console, mermaid or image errors, and no screen is text-only. At 390 px the four-row s1-table, the two-column s2-table and s4-table and the s3-diagram (flowchart TD) are all readable, and so are the code blocks: the 24-line practice-setup and the 25-line practice-answer with lines 6-12 highlighted. No code line wraps in a way that is hard to follow (pages/mobile-jp-19.png, pages/mobile-jp-25.png).

The lesson is long: 22 desktop screens and 33 mobile screens. Still, every screen has a heading, table, code block, steps or check, and the walls of text are broken up by definitions, tables and inline quizzes. The densest stretch is the practice section, where steps, a prompt, a checklist, a hint, two code blocks and a closing paragraph run for about 8 mobile screens (pages/mobile-jp-18.png to pages/mobile-jp-26.png).

This is a Japanese-only lesson, and the UI and content are all in Japanese. Diagram labels are Japanese and large enough at 390 px. Inline code chips stay whole and do not break Japanese words (for example `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` in s1-table, pages/mobile-jp-04.png). Contrast is fine on the callouts and on the expected-result boxes, and no control is hidden under the top or bottom bars.

niceToHave: s5-steps / practice-steps: each step title starts with a circled digit (① ...) right next to the reader's own numbered circle, so every number appears twice (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, pages/desktop-jp-11.png). Drop the circled digits from the titles.

practice-prompt: the prompt shows literal backticks around `.claude/settings.json`, `permissions.deny`, `CLAUDE.local.md` and `@` (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). That is fine as text to copy, but the result looks busy on mobile. Consider plain paths without backticks.

lesson (prerequisites): the prerequisite line takes about 6 lines of small grey text at 390 px before the objectives (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). Consider listing only the closest prerequisites, or shorter labels such as 第1-5回.

s4-table: at 390 px the `paths:` chip sits alone on its line and 付きのルール（6-3） wraps under it (pages/mobile-jp-14.png). This is readable, but the cell would read more cleanly as plain text, for example 「paths: 付きのルール（6-3）」, or as a reworded cell.
reader: desktop-jp charsPerLine median is 42 (max 50), against a target of 30-40, at a measure of 680 px. This is a reader layout setting, not a lesson problem.
reader: the end banner says 'このコースの最後のレッスンまで読み終えました' because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-33.png, pages/desktop-jp-22.png).
reader: metrics.json marks the mobile full-length PNG as truncated (it stops at 16000px), and 13 /api/ requests failed in the preview environment.
summary: The lesson's visual structure is its biggest strength: every screen has a table, diagram, code block, steps or check. The tables, the flowchart TD diagram and the long code blocks all stay readable at 390 px, there are no hard failures in metrics.json, and no screen shows personal data. Nothing must be fixed; the most worthwhile cleanup is removing the doubled numbering (① next to the reader's step circle) in s5-steps and practice-steps.
